# test-plan/ — generated by the Ejara Automation Tool

One JSON file per module of the Phoenix test plan (TC IDs, titles, labels and their tags, priority, platforms,
environments, automation status, former IDs, case version). **Never edit these files by hand**: change the case in
the tool, download the plan bundle (App page › Automation) and run `npm run plan:apply -- <bundle.json> --write`.

Tests link to their case with `tc('<TC ID>')` (src/test-plan/tags.ts): the test gets the case's tags
(`@smoke`, `@regression`, priority), so `--grep @smoke` follows the labels set in the tool.
While this folder has no JSON file, `tc()` reads src/test-plan/*.plan.json as before.
